content.subject: New sandbox tool cuts manual fulfillment testing
content.draft_text:
Hi Test,
ShipBob’s Simulation Terminal is now in every sandbox account. Operators often spend hours manually testing fulfillment flows before launch, juggling spreadsheets and error-prone reconciliations overall.
We build bots that reconcile fulfillment data automatically, removing manual entry steps and reducing error rates.
Could we schedule a quick brief call next week to explore if this fits your workflow?
Zamp
